cityMaterialAudit.method: SHA256 of actual attribute/index bytes, stable material properties and shader text, local/world transforms and instance matrices; excludes random UUIDs and shadow flags from stable key. Texture content is covered by source/asset manifests; texture metadata here is not a content hash. Morph/deforming shader time is not part of identity.

units: Final encoded RGB bytes, not linear luminance. Cross-revision differences are measured, not required to be zero; paired camera/time/look equality is reported. CPU PNG decoding only, no image edits. Raw geometry UV metric must be combined with texture repeat; ray hit is not fragment identity.
